— row_number() > Assigns a unique
sequential number to rows within a
partition.

v Get the latest record per group

— rank() > Assigns rank to rows, allowing
ties (same rank for equal values)

v Leaderboards, top-N analysis with ties

— dense_rank() > Like rank(), but
doesn’t skip ranks after ties

v Clean, gap-free rankings

— lag(column, offset) > Accesses the
previous row’s value in the partition

v Calculate differences between current
and past row

- lead(column, offset) > Accesses
the next row’s value in the partition
